title: yencoding-multi: add_part_auto_crc_verified_at_finish test uses code-under-test as CRC oracle
description: assembler.rs test: correct_crc = crc32fast::hash(&data) — this is the same function finish() calls internally. The Python oracle comment (0x2144_df1c for 4 zero bytes) is present but never used. Replace: let correct_crc: u32 = 0x2144_df1c; and delete the crc32fast::hash call.
